title: Transformers, power factor and motor torque

scenes.narration: Three ideas that power every grid: transformers, power factor and motor torque.
A transformer links two windings through a shared magnetic flux. With half as many secondary turns, the voltage is halved, so this one steps eleven thousand volts down.
Real power P and reactive power Q combine into apparent power S. The angle between P and S sets the power factor.
An induction motor starts with torque, peaks at breakdown, then settles just below synchronous speed.
